blocking_finding: Prepared ledger handles carry only a generation value. Distinct ledgers can independently produce the same generation and therefore accept a foreign prepared handle before publication.

invariants.note: No alternate SWAP kernel introduced.
Ledger code contains no file/path/parser I/O.
Ledger accounting remains separate runtime state.
Persistent ledger state is compact; no solver scratch retained.
No Newton/Jacobian scratch added to column state.
No layout constraint preventing pooled/batched runtime use.
A foreign prepared credential can authorize publication on another ledger, violating transactional ownership and fail-closed commit semantics.
No restriction on rerun or warm-start semantics introduced.
Coupling windows remain generic t0/t1 intervals.
No fixed daily coupling window assumption introduced.
Coupling transaction publication is core functionality and its prepared-handle ownership contract is not yet sound.
Mechanical q action-reaction convention remains exact; no claim of end-to-end aquifer closure is made.
Per-ledger mass publication can be authorized by a credential prepared for another logical ledger, so trustworthy mass-accounting ownership is not guaranteed.
No sensitivity-output contract is changed.
No additional full SWAP coupling runs are required.
Ledger state remains lightweight and does not require one heavy solver per logical column.
No one-to-one SWAP/MODFLOW cell assumption is introduced.
Deep-vadose remains outside this component.
No component-transition storage semantics are changed.
No soil-water solver implementation is selected or constrained.
No duplicated physical process implementation is introduced.
No HeadCalc internals are exposed or consumed.
No physics option is conflated with numerical policy.
Ledger publication is bounded local work; no unbounded solver path added.
Reference-mode availability is untouched.
A foreign prepared handle can publish another ledger's prepared diagnostics, so per-ledger transaction diagnostics are not provenance-safe.
Optional ledger functionality adds state only where instantiated.
System composition remains a runtime/coupler responsibility.
Prepared-handle provenance is an implicit same-ledger assumption rather than an explicit checked contract.
This audit explicitly evaluates all 30 architecture invariants and blocks admission on adverse deltas.
